correction.initialFailure: All six failures stopped because welcomeHero was missing from the accessibility tree; failure records are retained rather than replaced by passing reruns.
correction.unsuccessfulAttempt: Putting the accessibility element on the ZStack did not make the welcomeHero identifier discoverable; the two se-final failures preserve this intermediate attempt.
correction.successfulFix: The hero region exposes its accessible image through Spacer.accessibilityRepresentation. Both welcome tests then passed on the small screen and again on the large screen.
correction.finalSourceCoverage: After the small-screen accessible run passed, only the English welcome subtitle and indentation changed. The large-screen final run used the delivery source. Earlier passing language, retry/settlement and version-navigation paths were not rerun without a relevant behavioral change. The seven passes therefore span iterations, not seven executions of one final source snapshot.

screenshots.pixels: Copied byte-for-byte from the original exported PNGs. Existing manually captured QA screenshots were not overwritten.

metadataAudit.retainedMetadata: Only Screenshot description/comment, orientation 1, pixel dimensions, and standard color metadata; no device IDs, host paths, author or location data found.

privacy.logs: Repository/user/temp paths, device and installation identifiers, signer/profile/team metadata, and process/thread identifiers are redacted. Timing, test names and outcomes are preserved.
privacy.indexes: Contain only actual PNG paths, test identifiers, screenshot descriptions and timestamps. Device IDs/names, test URLs, binary snapshots and touch-event metadata are excluded.
privacy.rawEvidence: Original logs, exports and result bundles remain in local temporary storage; no raw identity mapping is included in this archive.

validation.systemPaths: Apple CoreSimulator runtime volume paths are retained; they contain OS runtime identifiers rather than a user-owned volume name.
